name: Law No. 13 of 2016 concerning Personal Data Privacy Protection
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Al Meezan — Qatar Legal Portal (almeezan.qa) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
